1001.en:
Dealing and receiving champion damage grants you 1 stack of Juggernauting for 6 seconds. For every 7 stacks of Juggernauting you gain 25 - 75 (based on level) Adaptive Force, 5 - 10 (based on level) Armor, 5 - 10 (based on level) Magic Resist, 10% Size, and 8% Tenacity.

Stacks fall off faster the more you have.
1001.zh:
在造成或承受英雄伤害时为你提供1层持续6秒的战神附体。每7层战神附体，你获得25 - 75（基于等级）适应之力、5 - 10（基于等级）护甲、5 - 10（基于等级）魔法抗性、10%体型和8%韧性。

你拥有的层数越多，层数就衰减得越快。

Gain 100 Item Haste (equivalent to 50% Item CDR).

Item Haste reduces the cooldown of all Item Abilities.

获得100装备急速(相当于50%装备冷却缩减)。

装备急速可缩减所有装备技能的冷却时间。

1005.en: Gain up to <speed>50% Move Speed</speed> toward nearby allies based on their <scaleHealth>missing Health</scaleHealth>. Your <healing>healing</healing> and <shield>shielding</shield> are also increased up to 50% based on the <scaleHealth>target's missing Health</scaleHealth>.

1006.en: Makes you untargetable while you dash at and deal 30 - 150 (based on level) (+10% bonus AD) (+6% AP) damage to enemies 8 times (deals 50% On-Hit damage).

1011.en: Casting your <attention>Ultimate</attention> makes you <status>Invulnerable</status> for 2 seconds (8s Cooldown).

When dropping below 50% Health, heal for 35% max Health over 3 seconds.
Resets on death or every 45 seconds.

在跌到50%生命值以下时，在3秒里持续回复共35%最大生命值。
阵亡时或每45秒重置。

Every 10 seconds, automatically cast the Aria of Perseverence and Song of Celerity in an alternating melody.

Damaging enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities different from the previous one grants Style (from F to S).

Gain 4.3% - 5% (based on level) Movement Speed per Style rank.

At S Style consume your Style to unleash a torrent of gunshots at all nearby enemies 10 times over 2 seconds. Each shot deals 20 - 40 (based on level) (+40% AD) (+25% AP) physical damage. Enemies below 30% Health are struck Critically for 0% AD + 0% AP physical damage.This has a 5 second Cooldown.

子弹会施加生命偷取并对小兵造成25%伤害。

Champion takedowns within 3 seconds of damaging them causes them to leave behind their Essence for 8 seconds. Attacking an Essence consumes it.
